description.value: Tutto is an authentic Italian restaurant in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, housed in a historic 1908 brick building at the corner of Homer and Smithe Streets. The dining room features colourful ceiling murals evoking the Italian Renaissance, elegantly curved wine cabinets, a lively wine bar, and private dining rooms anchored by a dramatic giraffe sculpture called 'Soprattutto.' A touring cyclist stopping here would encounter a full sit-down experience with fresh housemade pastas, premium seafood, house-made desserts, and expert sommelier-guided wine pairings.
